name: AGNC Investment Corp.
reason: Agency mortgage REIT whose earnings are set by rate spreads and hedging (losses in 2020 and 2022, net debt/EBITDA 22x, shares compounding 11%/yr) - no forecastable franchise.

name: Reinsurance Group of America, Inc.
reason: Disciplined life reinsurer with a long record, but EPS sits at its 10y peak (1.0x) after a 2021 pandemic hit to 1.13, and mortality/longevity and asset-intensive deal economics are too opaque to forecast with confidence (adj vs GAAP gap 27%).

name: HCA Healthcare, Inc.
reason: Best-in-class hospital operator (EPS CAGR 17.6%, shares -5.6%/yr) but EPS is at its 10y peak with margin in the 91st percentile and Medicaid/ACA reimbursement cuts are a credible government-payment threat within 5 years.

name: Pacira Biosciences, Inc.
reason: Essentially a single-product (EXPAREL) story facing generic/patent and reimbursement risk, with ROIC averaging -0.8% and adjusted EPS far above GAAP.

name: LegalZoom.com, Inc.
reason: Online legal forms with GAAP EPS of only $0.08 and EBIT margin 1.9% face credible AI disintermediation of document preparation.

name: Goldman Sachs BDC, Inc.
reason: Externally managed BDC tied to the middle-market credit cycle with EPS falling from 2.14 to 1.57 and consensus still declining (FY1 -19%).

name: Celanese Corp.
reason: Commodity-exposed acetyls/engineered materials chemical with EPS down to 0.22x its 10y peak after a debt-funded acquisition (acq/FCF 1.29) leaving net debt/EBITDA at 7.5x.

name: Comcast Corp.
reason: Cheap (6.2x) but broadband subscriber losses to fiber/fixed wireless and linear TV decline put the core under threat, with consensus FY1 EPS -20% and margin in the bottom decile.

name: Century Communities, Inc.
reason: Entry-level homebuilder whose EPS swung 16.16 to 5.99 with the housing cycle, margin at 3.9% (bottom decile) and net debt/EBITDA 7.0x.

name: GoDaddy, Inc.

name: Ladder Capital Corp.
reason: Commercial mortgage REIT dependent on CRE credit and spreads with EPS at 0.28x its 10y peak and net debt/EBITDA 12.6x.

name: Ally Financial, Inc.
reason: Auto lender whose earnings follow the credit and rate cycle (EPS 8.61 in 2021 to 2.35 in 2024), a spread-dependent business without specialness.

name: Herbalife Ltd.
reason: Multi-level-marketing nutrition company with flat revenue (1.2% 10y CAGR), EPS 0.44x its peak, net debt/EBITDA 3.25x and persistent regulatory/model risk.

name: Salesforce, Inc.
reason: Strong CRM franchise with margin at a 10y high (21.5%), but AI agents threaten seat-based pricing within 5 years, growth has relied on large acquisitions (acq/FCF 0.6) and adjusted EPS is far above GAAP.

name: YETI Holdings, Inc.
reason: Premium cooler/drinkware brand with EPS flat since 2021 (2.57 to 2.48), margin down from 27% to 11% and easy imitation by Stanley and private label - a good brand without a durable moat.

name: CBRE Group, Inc.
reason: Scale leader in commercial real estate services, but EPS is at its 10y peak, leasing and capital-markets fees follow the CRE transaction cycle, and net debt/EBITDA is 3.96x with acquisitions at 0.41x FCF.

name: Navient Corp.
reason: Shrinking student-loan portfolio in runoff (revenue -5%/yr, 2025 EPS -0.35) with net debt/EBITDA 15.7x and policy risk.

name: Crown Holdings, Inc.
reason: Beverage-can oligopoly but EPS is at its 10y peak with margin at a 10y high, ROIC averages only 5.3% and growth has leaned on acquisitions (acq/FCF 0.77) - good but not special.

name: Customers Bancorp, Inc.
reason: Commercial bank with volatile earnings (8.91 in 2021 to 5.09 in 2024) driven by rate-sensitive and concentrated deposit franchises rather than a durable low-cost moat.
